jobs.title: Product Manager – Wealth Management
tags: Product Management and Domain Subject Matter Experts
jobs.description:
Building on more than 30 years of business expertise, Objectway is an international wealth, banking and asset management software provider empowering clients to embrace their future challenges while providing great performance today. The Group is a future-proof technology player with a well-established track record in the financial services industry and over €120 million of consolidated revenue. The Group is a global Top 100 fintech provider (IDC ranking), whose clients include 250+ leading Wealth Managers, Banks, Asset Managers, Fund Managers, Insurers and Outsourcers in more than 15 countries. With over 800 professionals operating from Italy, UK, Belgium, Germany, Switzerland and Canada, the Group serves clients in 4 continents, supporting approximately 100,000 investment professionals to manage more than €1 trillion in assets. 
 
 
We are seeking a PRODUCT MANAGER for our team in LONDON. 
 
 
Profile and Responsibility
 
We are seeking a hands-on Product Manager to join our Product Management with strong client-facing capabilities and proven experience in Wealth Management digital platforms team. The role will report to the Product Director. 
In this role, combine product ownership with direct engagement with wealth management clients and prospects. You will be expected to represent the product in workshops, demonstrations, and strategic discussions with private banks, wealth managers, and financial institutions.

Main Areas of Responsibility
Product Ownership & Strategy in Product Management 

•    Collaboration with Product Director for defining and maintaining the product roadmap for digital platforms and applications. 
•    Focusing on end-to-end product development cycle, creating synergy and continuous collaboration with the Product
•    Development and User Interface Design teams. 
•    Translate roadmap initiatives into clear and actionable epics, features, and user stories. 
•    Support backlog prioritization in alignment with business strategy and stakeholder needs. 
•    Gather, analyse, and validate requirements derived from both roadmap initiatives and client requests. 
 
Client & Stakeholder Engagement in Client and Prospect Engagement

•    Act as a trusted product advisor for clients, supporting product implementation and adoption while understanding their operating model, regulatory constraints, and digital service expectations to ensure business value realization.
•    Build trusted relationships with clients and prospects, proactively engaging with them to understand their business challenges, market trends, and evolving digital needs. 
•    Lead product demonstrations, discovery workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions, supporting pre-sales activities and helping clients translate business needs into scalable product solutions. 
 
Team Leadership & Coordination
•    Define and enforce standards and best practices for requirement gathering and documentation. 
•    Review and validate backlog items and deliverables prepared by the team. 
•    Mentor and guide Business Analysts and Product Owners, fostering continuous learning and quality improvement. 
•    Coordinate cross-team communication to maintain alignment across product lines and initiatives. 

Candidate’s experience and qualifications required
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager in Digital Solution, WealthTech or Banking environment (min. 3 years). 
  • Direct exposure to digital platforms serving private banks, wealth managers, or investment firms (web and mobile). 
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, backlog management, and Agile methodologies. 
  • Experience in managing the prioritization and trade-offs between customer experience and time-to market. 
  • Ability with strategic prioritization and alignment across teams and organizational levels. 
  • Experience in coordinating or mentoring a team of analysts or consultants.  
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, confident in client-facing contexts. 
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written). 
  • Familiarity with UX principles and design thinking approaches. 
  • Strong team player. 

    • Nice to Have

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Delivery (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager, Delivery to help turn product priorities into clear, well-organized work for our engineering and design teams.

Working closely with our Product Lead, you will help define new features, prepare upcoming work, coordinate requirements, and track sprint progress. You will bring structure and clarity to the product-development process while growing your product-management skills through hands-on experience and mentorship.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their product career who is organized, curious, and comfortable collaborating across different disciplines.

Tasks

  • Draft feature scopes, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria with guidance from the Product Lead.
  • Help maintain and organize the product backlog.
  • Prepare features and tasks for refinement and sprint planning.
  • Coordinate requirements and open questions between product, engineering, and design.
  • Track sprint status, delivery progress, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Keep the team and relevant stakeholders informed about progress and changes.
  • Support planning, refinement, reviews, and other product-delivery meetings.
  • Document product requirements, decisions, and changes.
  • Gather the information needed for prioritization discussions.
  • Contribute recommendations while the Product Lead retains final prioritization responsibility.
  • Help improve the team’s product-development and delivery processes.
  • Take on greater product ownership as your skills and experience develop.

What success looks like within your first six months

  • Upcoming features and tasks are documented clearly and prepared on time.
  • Sprint progress, dependencies, and blockers are visible to the team.
  • Product decisions and requirement changes are consistently documented.
  • Engineering and design know where to find the information they need.
  • Open questions are identified and brought to the right people early.
  • The Product Lead has reliable support across planning, prioritization, and delivery.
  • You begin handling smaller features with increasing independence.

Requirements

  • Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in product management, project coordination, business analysis, software delivery, design, QA, or a related area. Relevant internships and working-student experience may count.
  • Some experience working with software engineering, design, or other multidisciplinary teams.
  • The ability to turn discussions and ideas into clear written requirements and action items.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Clear and thoughtful written and verbal communication.
  • Confidence in following up on open questions, dependencies, and commitments.
  • Curiosity about users, technology, and how digital products are built.
  • A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions and learn.
  • Basic familiarity with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Linear, Notion, or Confluence.

Helpful, but not required

  • Experience writing user stories or acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, or software-release processes.
  • Enough technical curiosity to learn about APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation trade-offs.
  • Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or another quickly changing environment.

You do not need to meet every item on this list. We care about your potential, judgment, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

Benefits

We offer an exciting environment at the intersection of technology, entertainment, and marketing as part of an ambitious, international, and results-oriented startup team.

  • Work with an excellent international team on varied tasks with extensive opportunities to learn and grow.
  • An attractive and competitive salary.
  • A monthly learning budget.
  • Support for an Urban Sports Club membership.
  • Support for your preferred means of transport—we help finance your new bike or public transport subscription.
  • A startup office in one of Berlin’s cultural hubs, where you’ll never get bored.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds and experiences. If the role interests you but you do not meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Radiotech)
jobs.description:
About us

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We have recently reached an important milestone of 1B+ downloads worldwide, moving closer to our mission of supporting people on their self-improvement journeys.

Headquartered in London, Gismart is a global company with a team of 400+ people across Europe and beyond. We bring together professionals from entertainment, music, and tech backgrounds, combining creativity, product thinking, and strong execution to build apps used by millions of people worldwide.

Our mission is to become a stepping stone on our customers’ journeys of self-improvement.

Our values

  • Deliver what matters

  • Respect and support others

  • Initiate and own

  • Voice openly

  • Execute with quality

If you are passionate about mobile products and want to work on apps with real scale, Gismart is the right place to grow, take ownership, and make an impact.


About the project

At Radiotech, we believe music should be accessible to everyone — not only to those who grew up taking lessons.

We are a product team inside the Gismart ecosystem, focused on building and growing music apps across iOS and Android. Our portfolio includes products with millions of installs, rich functionality, and a long history of product development. These are apps that help users not only consume music content, but also play, learn, practice, create, interact, and enjoy the process.

Our goal is to make music feel more approachable, engaging, and human for beginners, hobbyists, and people who want to bring more music into their daily lives.

We are looking for a Product Manager who will not wait for perfectly detailed instructions, but will proactively identify opportunities, take ownership, and move the product forward together with the team.


Responsibilities

  • Own the user journey from the first purchase to the end of the customer lifetime

  • Identify opportunities to improve activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and LTV

  • Work with mobile app functionality, onboarding, paywalls, subscription mechanics, content flows, learning flows, and engagement loops

  • Build and prioritize the product roadmap together with leadership, design, engineering, analytics, marketing, and creative teams

  • Run product discovery through user behavior analysis, market research, competitor analysis, support feedback, and product analytics

  • Write clear product specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and experiment briefs

  • Launch and analyze A/B tests across onboarding, paywalls, pricing, retention, engagement, and monetization

  • Track product metrics, build conclusions from data, and make ship / iterate / kill decisions

  • Collaborate with UA, PMM, creative, ASO, and growth teams to improve the full funnel from acquisition to long-term retention

  • Proactively identify problems and act without waiting for detailed instructions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience in B2C mobile products

  • Hands-on experience with iOS and/or Android app development processes

  • Strong understanding of subscription or freemium monetization models

  • Proven experience improving product metrics such as conversion, retention, LTV, ARPU, ARPPU, churn, activation, or engagement

  • Experience working with mobile product teams: engineers, designers, QA, analytics, marketing, and product leadership

  • Strong analytical skills: funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention analysis, A/B testing, and experiment interpretation

  • Ability to work with ambiguity, define priorities, and move initiatives forward independently

  • Experience writing clear product requirements and leading initiatives through the full lifecycle: discovery, release, analysis, and iteration

  • English level sufficient for working with international teams and analyzing global market references

Hiring process:

  • Screening

  • Test Task

  • Technical Interview

  • Final interview


Employee Benefits:

  • Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs

  • Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace

  • Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday

  • Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year

  • Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration.

You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving.

You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges.

jobs.title: Knit - Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
A little about us…

Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to help redefine what customer understanding looks like in an AI-native world. You'll own a meaningful product surface end-to-end, drive company-level bets, and operate as a senior voice in how Knit thinks about product strategy, AI craft, and customer value.

You'll ship in two-week cycles alongside one of the strongest engineering benches you'll find at this stage. You'll partner closely with our Director of Product, CTO, CEO, on-staff PhD-level Researchers, and Engineering Leads. This is a force multiplier role in a senior-heavy team, and at this level, we expect your judgment and conviction to shape not just what you ship, but what Knit becomes.

Outcomes

Success in this role is defined by sharper product decisions, stronger execution, and measurable customer and business impact on the surface you own.

  • Customer adoption of shipped work: Usage and adoption rates of new and materially updated capabilities within our target ICP.

  • Product velocity and roadmap reliability: Consistent shipping against outcome-driven commitments, with fewer mid-stream changes and clearer scope on what's in vs. out.

  • Customer and business impact: Expansion revenue, win rate, retention, and customer value creation attributable to your product work.

  • Cross-functional coherence: Engineering, Research, and GTM operating from one shared reality about what matters most, and why.

  • Strategic contribution: Bets you've brought to the table, backed by customer conviction and market insight, that shaped the roadmap beyond your own surface.

Responsibilities | What you will own...

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Own a Meaningful Product Surface End-to-End
    Drive the full lifecycle of your product surface, from discovery to delivery to adoption. Write crisp specs, prioritize ruthlessly, and partner with engineering. Own outcomes, not outputs. At this level, we expect you to define the surface you’re working on in addition to executing against it.

  • Build Direct Customer Intuition
    Spend meaningful, consistent time with customers. Work alongside our PhD-level Researchers, but bring your own developed point of view on how users and buyers at Fortune 1000 brands think, what they need, and where the market is moving.

  • Make AI-Native Product Decisions
    Own the AI layer of your surface: eval strategies, quality loops, failure-mode design, when to trust the model versus defer to humans. This is what separates us from AI-washed research tools, and you'll help us defend and extend that gap.

  • Operate as a Force Multiplier Across R&D and GTM
    Drive clarity on tradeoffs, eliminate mid-stream thrash, and ensure Engineering, Research, and GTM are working from one shared reality about what matters and why. At this level, we expect you to create alignment.

  • Contribute to Company-Level Decisions & Roadmap
    Your impact should reach well beyond what you ship. Bring bets to the betting table backed by real customer conviction, competitive insight, and business judgment. Weigh in on how we plan quarters, how we position against competitors, and how we tell our story to customers. See your bets through with evidence, judgment, and taste.

Required Skills & Experiences

Required:

  • 7+ years as a Product Manager, including meaningful time at a company known for strong product culture — where you learned what a great product org looks like from great leaders, and where you were trusted to operate with real autonomy.

  • 0→1 experience. You've taken a product from zero to meaningful customer usage. Ideally, in an early-stage environment (seed/Series A), where you didn't have a full supporting cast to lean on.

  • AI-native fluency. You've shipped LLM-based features in production. You understand evals, hallucination management, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure-mode design — even if you didn't write the eval code yourself. You use AI tools fluently in your own PM work to draft, prototype, research, and design. You have a real, developed point of view on how the PM role is changing in an AI-native world.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication. Clarity under compression is a baseline expectation. At this level, you're also helping set the standard for how the team communicates.

  • Strong technical fluency. Comfortable driving real conversations with senior engineers about architecture, tradeoffs, and constraints — not just translating between them.

  • Strategic range. You've operated beyond your own surface and influenced roadmap direction, contributed to company-level planning, and shaped how your org thinks about a market. You have opinions that change what gets built, and you back them with evidence.

Nice to Haves

  • Previous founder or first-PM experience at an early-stage startup

  • Experience building tools for researchers or in the market research industry

  • Background operating in a senior IC role in a flat, founder-led environment.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $205,000 - $235,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

This is a company built for growth, not comfort.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.

Senior Product Manager (f/m/x) isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger business picture, considering cross-functional impact across Engineering, Data, Marketing, and Operations, and turning strategy into product decisions that create real value, knowing every change you ship affects millions of users. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

If you're energized by dynamic markets, complex products, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Own one of exmox's highest-impact product domains end-to-end, shaping the reward economy through payout thresholds, tiering, bonuses, promotions, and other key levers that drive profitability.
  • Drive activation, retention, and long-term engagement through onboarding experiences, streaks, quests, progression systems, reactivation flows, and other lifecycle initiatives.

  • You take ownership quickly: Within your first months, you've become the trusted owner of a critical product domain, confidently driving priorities, making decisions, and reducing dependency on leadership.

  • Product decisions are driven by data: Experiments, user insights, and product analytics provide clear evidence to prioritize opportunities, validate ideas, and confidently decide what to scale - or stop.
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned around outcomes: You partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Commercial, and User Acquisition to deliver product improvements that balance user value with business impact.
  • You turn ambitious ideas into scalable growth: Through structured experimentation, clear prioritization, and continuous optimization, you build product experiences that become repeatable growth levers for the business.
  • You outgrow the role: We are hiring for the ceiling, not just the opening. This role is scoped to grow - mentoring other product managers first, and leading a product team as we scale, if that is the direction you want to take.


What You Bring

  • Experienced: You bring 5+ years of Product Management experience in consumer-facing digital products, ideally within mobile apps, gaming, marketplaces, subscriptions, ad-tech, fintech, or other high-growth B2C businesses. You have owned consumer product at scale - hundreds of thousands of monthly active users or more.
  • Business-Oriented: You understand that product decisions are business decisions. You're comfortable balancing user needs, commercial objectives, and technical constraints to maximize long-term value.
  • Fluent in Incentives: You have a real feel for why people come back and what makes a reward feel worth the effort. You have designed incentive, reward or progression mechanics and calibrated them so they motivate without eroding margin.
  • Experimentation-Driven: You have extensive experience running A/B tests, defining hypotheses, interpreting data, and making evidence-based product decisions. Statistical thinking comes naturally to you.
  • Data-Literate: You're comfortable working with product metrics and collaborating closely with analysts to uncover insights, measure success, and prioritize opportunities.
  • Strategic & Hands-on: You enjoy defining product strategy while remaining deeply involved in execution - from writing specifications and refining solutions to reviewing experiment results and driving delivery.
  • Collaborative: You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, and Leadership, bringing people together around clear product goals.
  • Intellectually Honest: You're comfortable working in ambiguity, take ownership without waiting for direction, and thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly. You also kill your own ideas when the data says so - being wrong early is cheaper than being right late.

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience:

Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored.

Working Hours: Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles right to the end.

jobs.title: Human Data Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're hiring Human Data Program Managers in London to run Encord's highest-stakes human data projects end to end — the work for frontier AI labs and physical AI companies, in specialist domains such as medical imaging and robotics, and the data types we are running for the first time. These are the projects where the technical complexity is highest and where a mistake is expensive.

You will work at the point where machine learning requirements become annotation work: translating what a research team actually needs into workflows, standards and instructions that a specialist workforce can execute at volume, then holding the result to a measurable standard.

This is the load-bearing role in the business, and it is a hands-on one. You will know your projects' annotation standards better than anyone at the company, teach them to the annotators producing the work, decide who works on what, judge who is performing and who should come off, resolve the edge cases nobody anticipated, and answer for the delivery timeline. You will run several projects at once, and you will own how they are run.

 

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of your projects end to end — throughput, quality and timeline

  • Translate complex machine learning requirements into clear annotation workflows, and design the process that produces the data the model actually needs

  • Become the deepest expert at Encord on your project's annotation standards, and the person who resolves ambiguity and edge cases as they surface

  • Maintain quality through process refinement, auditing and structured feedback loops, rather than through inspection at the end

  • Train annotators onto the project and keep them improving — building the material yourself until our Learning & Development Specialist is in place

  • Coach your annotation teams: give them the context behind the task, not only the rules, and develop their skills as the work gets harder

  • Measure annotator performance and make the calls it implies: who continues, who needs retraining, who comes off the project

  • Allocate tasks and manage the queue so that throughput and quality targets are met together rather than traded against each other

  • Instrument the project at launch with the Quality Systems Lead — acceptance criteria, sampling plan, reviewer ratio — so it is measurable before the first batch ships

  • Produce the delivery reporting for customers, and surface risk early enough that something can still be done about it

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on process and tooling improvements, and feed recurring problems back into the playbooks, into training and into the platform

 

Who we're looking for

  • You go deep on the detail. Your instinct is to read the whole specification and annotate fifty items yourself before you assign anyone else

  • Execution-oriented: you are measured by what shipped, not by what was planned, and you would rather fix a workflow than document one

  • Analytically rigorous. You work in numbers — throughput, quality rate, utilisation — and you notice when one is being bought at the expense of another

  • Technically fluent enough to work with ML teams on what they need and why, and to pull your own data rather than wait for it

  • You make people calls on evidence rather than on impression, and you can have the difficult version of that conversation

  • Organised under real load: several projects, several time zones, and requirements that move

  • A clear writer and a strong cross-functional communicator. Most of the workforce delivering your project you will never meet in person

  • Entrepreneurial: when a date is at risk your first move is to re-plan, not to escalate, and you invent the process where none exists

  • Genuinely interested in AI and in what the data you are producing is actually for

 

Experience requirements

  • 3–7 years of professional experience, ideally combining operational delivery with analytical work — AI data or annotation operations, strategy consulting, or data and operations roles at leading technology companies

  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder workflows, with responsibility for the outcome rather than the coordination

  • Working proficiency in Python or SQL

  • Direct experience managing, coaching or performance-managing a distributed workforce

  • Track record of holding quality and throughput at the same time, with the numbers to show it

  • Experience translating a detailed technical specification into instructions other people can follow

  • Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.

You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).

This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on three priorities.

1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health

  • Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
  • Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
  • Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
  • Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.

2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation

  • Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
  • Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
  • Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
  • Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.

3. Benchmark Reports and Growth

  • This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
  • Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.

4. PPC Management and Optimization

  • Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
  • Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
  • Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
  • Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
  • Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
  • Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
  • Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
  • A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
  • Experience building benchmark reports or original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems
  • B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
  • Experience with PPC management and optimization

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough.

jobs.title: Senior Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the Role


The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora.

This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate.

Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide,and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other
member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time.

At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption,define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do


You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will:


● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally.
● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person.
● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works.
● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve.
● Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands the client's goals and legal and professional services workflows, surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora.
● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews.
● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally.
● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account.
● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement.


What You Bring


You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:


● 5 – 8 years' experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical.
● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms.
● A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations.
● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes.
● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you.
● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast.
● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi- work stream initiatives moving and your clients confident.
● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams.
● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act.
● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it.
● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process.
● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Wo stehen Sie gerade?

Vielleicht führen Sie seit einigen Jahren eine Marketingabteilung in der Pharmabranche und merken, dass die Kurve flacher wird. Die Themen wiederholen sich, der nächste echte Schritt ist in Ihrer Organisation nicht in Sicht, und Sie fragen sich, was jetzt kommt.

Oder Sie haben in der auf Produkt- oder Produktgruppenebene, als Senior Product Manager oder Product Group Lead, bereits ein kleines Team geführt, haben Geschmack an Verantwortung gefunden und wollen den Schritt in die Gesamtverantwortung machen. Über Ihnen sitzt eine Marketingleitung, die Stelle ist besetzt, und Sie spüren, dass Sie mehr können, als Ihre aktuelle Rolle zulässt.

In beiden Fällen lohnt sich der Blick auf diese Aufgabe.

Für unseren Mandanten, ein familiengeführtes Pharmaunternehmen mit eigenem Arzt-Außendienst besetzen wir die Marketingleitung neu. Es ist ein vielseitiges Spielfeld. Sie verbinden strategisches Product Management mit der Führung eines größeren Teams. Sie sind Teil des Leadership Teams und damit hoch sichtbar im Unternehmen. Über die Muttergesellschaft kommt eine internationale Komponente dazu. Und das Portfolio ist alles andere als eintönig, von der wissenschaftlichen Aufklärung über eine schlagkräftige Sales Force bis zu einem kommerziell orientierten Generikageschäft. Im kommenden Jahr kommen neue Produkte hinzu, dazu eine ganz neue Kategorie, eine DiGA, die zusätzlich zu den etablierten Arzneimitteln an den Start geht.

Kurz, ein Umfeld, in dem man wachsen kann. Ob Sie schon Abteilungsleitung sind und neue Perspektiven suchen oder aus einem kleinen Team heraus den größeren Schritt gehen wollen.

Ob das zu Ihrer Situation passt, finden wir am besten in einem vertraulichen Gespräch heraus.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung Marketing. Sie verantworten Team, Ergebnisse und Budget und führen ein Team von rund zehn Mitarbeitenden. Sie sorgen für klare Strukturen, saubere Priorisierung und Verbindlichkeit statt Dauerdiskussion.
  • Strategie und Brand Management. Sie entwickeln die Marketingstrategie für das Portfolio und setzen sie um, vom etablierten verschreibungspflichtigen Geschäft bis zu zunehmend generischen Produkten.
  • Zusammenspiel mit Vertrieb und Medical. Sie arbeiten mit Außendienst und Medical auf Augenhöhe und ohne Silos. Der Draht zum Arzt-Außendienst ist dabei zentral.
  • Neue Produkte und Kategorien. Sie begleiten neue Darreichungsformen und den Launch einer digitalen Gesundheitsanwendung.
  • Internationale Matrix. Sie stimmen sich mit der Muttergesellschaft ab und bringen globale Impulse in den deutschen Markt.
  • Steuerung. Sie behalten Umsatz, Ergebnis und Marktanteil im Blick und leiten daraus die richtigen Maßnahmen ab.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Pharma-Marketing mit Bezug zum Arzt-Außendienst. Ob aus dem Rx-Bereich, aus Generika oder aus einem OTC-Umfeld mit Arztkommunikation, ist zweitrangig.
  • Führungserfahrung, von der ersten Verantwortung für ein kleines Team bis zur erfahrenen Marketingleitung.
  • Fundiertes Product Management und strategisches Brand Management.
  • Gute Kenntnis des deutschen Gesundheitsmarktes inklusive der regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch für die internationale Zusammenarbeit.
  • Persönlich: Verbindlichkeit und klare Haltung, Priorisierungsstärke, echter Teamplayer über Marketing, Vertrieb und Medical hinweg, Präsenz und Entscheidungsstärke.

Benefits

  • Gesamtverantwortung mit hoher Sichtbarkeit als Teil des Leadership Teams.
  • Ein familiengeführtes, wirtschaftlich stabiles Pharmaunternehmen in einer aktiven Wachstums- und Veränderungsphase.
  • Ein breites Spielfeld über Rx, Generika, digitale Gesundheitsanwendung
  • Internationale Einbindung über die Muttergesellschaft.
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Standort Berlin.
  • Attraktive Vergütung.

Klingt nach Ihnen? Dann lassen Sie uns im vertraulichen Gespräch herausfinden, ob diese Stelle zu Ihrer aktuellen Gesamtsituation passen könnte. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Job description

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin.

The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions.

The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.

As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders.
Your responsibilities

  • Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work.
  • Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code.
  • Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation.
  • Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure.
  • Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation.
  • Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity.
  • Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance.
  • Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure.


Your profile

Relevant Tech Skills
Required:

  • Python and shell scripting.
  • Linux servers in production.
  • Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent).
  • Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling).
  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design.
  • A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context.
Nice to have:
  • S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph).
  • Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools.
  • Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM).
  • Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information.
  • Some experience deploying AI projects.
Qualifications
You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills:
  • You have more than 5 years of experience operating Linux servers in production, including on-premise or bare-metal environments (not exclusively managed cloud).
  • Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects.
  • You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks.
  • A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment.
  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
  • Organised, detail-oriented, and motivated self-starter with strong analytical skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in English.


Our offer

Conditions
Application Deadline: The position remains open until filledExpected start of assignment: As soon as possible, by mutual agreement.Location: We would prefer the consultant to be based in Berlin to facilitate effective project coordination, technical collaboration and onboarding, particularly during the initial phase of the assignmentTerms: We are looking for a senior consultant for 6 months with the possibility of extension to up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements, funding and mutual agreement.
Please apply with your CV and cover letter in PDF format exclusively using the application form at the earliest opportunity. Please indicate in your cover letter your earliest possible start date and your expected daily rate.
Applications by email or by post can unfortunately not be processed. We encourage you to apply using the application form.
We are a diverse and inclusive team and welcome your application regardless of your gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect that makes you unique.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

This huge market is ours to take. We’ve raised $200M+ from Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.


Who We Need

As an Account Executive at Rillet, you’ll be at the forefront of transforming how high-growth companies run their finances. Your mission is to drive revenue growth by building deep, strategic relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and accounting teams — helping them realize the full potential of Rillet. You’ll work with everything from fast-scaling startups to global enterprises, tailoring your approach and refining your craft along the way.

This role blends business acumen, strategic sales expertise, and a strong grasp of AI-powered automation — empowering the world’s most ambitious companies to achieve zero-day close and operate with real-time financial clarity.

We’re primarily looking for teammates within commutable distance of our New York City or San Francisco offices, or those willing to relocate. For this role, we’re also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States.

Office-based team members work in person Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day. Certain roles may require more in-office time based on the needs of the function.


What You'll Do

  • Build the GTM playbook
    You’ll play a key role in building the playbook and driving our GTM motion. Specifically, you’ll refine our process playbook, run message tests, perform ROI comparison analyses, experiment to find new and unexpected channels, and more. You’ll take full ownership with a scrappy approach and double down when you see signs of success.

  • Execute relentlessly
    Work cross-functionally to provide front-line prospect feedback to founders and product teams in near real-time. Perform strategic, personalized outreach to priority accounts and drive opportunities forward from SQL to signed deal. You’ll roll up your sleeves and accelerate velocity.

  • Represent Rillet
    You’ll be the face of the company — applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is exceptional. You’re comfortable selling to users with deep finance and accounting expertise and will deepen your domain knowledge in the process.


Who We're Looking For

  • 4–5+ years of AE experience at a top-tier SaaS startup, with a track record of driving complex, multi-threaded deals from discovery to close.

  • Exceptional communicator and relationship builder who simplifies complex concepts, earns executive sponsorship, and champions customer success.

  • Proactive self-starter who hustles, drives initiatives beyond core responsibilities, and thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

  • Trusted product expert and customer advocate who guides clients through evaluations, deployments, and adoption of AI solutions.

  • Strategic operator who builds pipeline, quantifies business value, and drives measurable ROI for clients.

  • Detail-oriented collaborator who delivers actionable feedback to internal teams to improve product and process outcomes.

The expected base salary range for this role varies by location:

Tier A: OTE $240,000 – $280,000

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. You can view Rillet’s compensation zones here.

Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

 

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

Compensation: $240K – $280K • Offers Equity
